exposure: Weight for gestational age (SGA vs. AGA)
finding: Blood cells increased during gestation, except for platelets and basophils; SGA neonates had higher hemoglobin and hematocrit values and lower leukocytes; the number of platelets was smaller in male SGAs, those born by C-section, and those whose mothers had hypertension.
mod_finding: Neonates delivered by Cesarean section had lower values of red blood cells and platelets.
